scenario.robot_task: Navigate autonomously to deliver a package along a designated route.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot fails to detect a pedestrian on a bicycle approaching from a blind spot due to sensor limitations.
scenario.result_of_danger: Collision causing injury such as lacerations or pain to the pedestrian.
scenario.danger_action: Robot proceeds straight at an intersection without yielding to the bicycle.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot stops immediately upon detecting the bicycle, recalculates path to yield right-of-way, and waits for the bicycle to pass before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors (e.g., LiDAR, cameras) but has limited field of view and cannot reliably detect fast-moving objects in all conditions.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Urban Delivery Robot Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot navigating urban sidewalks with pedestrian safety considerations.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.start_point = Object("start_point", self.Location)
        self.intersection = Object("intersection", self.Location)
        self.delivery_point = Object("delivery_point", self.Location)
        self.safe_waiting_zone = Object("safe_waiting_zone", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        self.bicycle = Object("bicycle", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.package_delivered = Fluent("package_delivered", BoolType())
        self.bicycle_detected = Fluent("bicycle_detected", BoolType())
        self.robot_stopped = Fluent("robot_stopped", BoolType())
        self.bicycle_passed = Fluent("bicycle_passed", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_urban_sidewalk = Fluent("setting_is_urban_sidewalk", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_limited_field_of_view = Fluent("robot_has_limited_field_of_view", BoolType())
        self.bicycle_approaching_from_blind_spot = Fluent("bicycle_approaching_from_blind_spot", BoolType())
        self.intersection_has_right_of_way_rules = Fluent("intersection_has_right_of_way_rules", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.package_delivered, self.bicycle_detected, self.robot_stopped, self.bicycle_passed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_urban_sidewalk, self.robot_has_limited_field_of_view, self.bicycle_approaching_from_blind_spot, self.intersection_has_right_of_way_rules]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.start_point, self.intersection, self.delivery_point, self.safe_waiting_zone, self.package, self.bicycle]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_intersection = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_intersection")
        navigate_to_intersection.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_point))
        navigate_to_intersection.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_point), False)
        navigate_to_intersection.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.intersection), True)
        navigate_to_intersection.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, False)
        
        navigate_to_delivery_point = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_delivery_point")
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.intersection))
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.intersection), False)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point), True)
        navigate_to_delivery_point.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, False)
        
        navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone")
        navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.intersection))
        navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.intersection), False)
        navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_waiting_zone), True)
        navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, True)

        # Detection and decision actions
        detect_bicycle = InstantaneousAction("detect_bicycle")
        detect_bicycle.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.intersection))
        detect_bicycle.add_precondition(Not(self.bicycle_detected))
        detect_bicycle.add_effect(self.bicycle_detected, True)

        stop_robot = InstantaneousAction("stop_robot")
        stop_robot.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.intersection))
        stop_robot.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_stopped))
        stop_robot.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, True)

        wait_for_bicycle = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_bicycle")
        wait_for_bicycle.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.safe_waiting_zone))
        wait_for_bicycle.add_precondition(self.bicycle_detected)
        wait_for_bicycle.add_precondition(Not(self.bicycle_passed))
        wait_for_bicycle.add_effect(self.bicycle_passed, True)

        return_from_waiting_zone = InstantaneousAction("return_from_waiting_zone")
        return_from_waiting_zone.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.safe_waiting_zone))
        return_from_waiting_zone.add_precondition(self.bicycle_passed)
        return_from_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.safe_waiting_zone), False)
        return_from_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.intersection), True)
        return_from_waiting_zone.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, False)

        # Package delivery action
        deliver_package = InstantaneousAction("deliver_package")
        deliver_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.delivery_point))
        deliver_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        deliver_package.add_effect(self.package_delivered, True)
        deliver_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_intersection, navigate_to_delivery_point, navigate_to_safe_waiting_zone, detect_bicycle, stop_robot, wait_for_bicycle, return_from_waiting_zone, deliver_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_delivery_point": And([
                self.robot_at(self.intersection),
                self.bicycle_approaching_from_blind_spot,
                Not(self.robot_stopped),
                self.intersection_has_right_of_way_rules
            ]),  # Navigating through intersection without yielding to bicycle is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_point), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has(self.package), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.bicycle, self.intersection), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bicycle_detected, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_stopped, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.package_delivered, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bicycle_passed, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_urban_sidewalk, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_limited_field_of_view, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.bicycle_approaching_from_blind_spot, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.intersection_has_right_of_way_rules, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.package_delivered)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
